visualCharacteristics: Home page top-news stage: a large linked image panel on the left (about 66%) with a stacked list of tab labels on the right (about 34%). The active tab shows its panel with a 'Weiterlesen' call-to-action box over the image. Below 720px each tab label becomes a heading above its own panel.
contentPattern: One row per tab. Cells are classified by content in any order: link-free paragraph(s) form the tab label (e.g. Kicker teaser text), a picture is the panel image, and a paragraph holding a single link is the panel link (its text is the call-to-action). Rows without an image stay below the block as plain content.
usage: Top-news stage at the top of the home page, switching between featured stories.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any tabbed image teaser where each tab has a short label, one image and one link. Not for plain text tabs or single heroes (use hero).
